review:
A demonic nursery with cascades and a Total Win Bar that holds every win until the cascades finish. '6' symbols only activate after at least one win, and each one spins a Wailing Wheel where it landed.

Wheels can stop on a bronze, silver or gold cash prize, an adding multiplier, a multiplying one, or an instant max win. Because they resolve after the cascades, a couple of multiplying results can blow up a modest total. The Pray for Three sequel, with the cap lifted to 20,000x.
